command.stable_when_stalled: opcode, payload, banks, transaction ID and generations held stable until acceptance
command.conditional_operands: QUANTIZE mode2/3 uses banks0,1,2; dynamic modes use0,2 only; DEQUANTIZE0,2; ignored encoded bank1=0 is not acquired

response.identity: compare against accepted record, never current PC or current owner
response.finish: all accepted read responses consumed and processed; all final data, scale and BF16 writes accepted; no further memory request after completion

ownership: Use single-exclusive role IDs; acquire every used operand atomically on command acceptance, release matching captured roles only on valid identity. Retain response/identity until release accepted.
in_place: ROPE and SOFTMAX acquire one read-write data role, no duplicate bank acquisition; three-bank GEMM inputs/output distinct.

shared_engines.GEMM_INT8_ATTN_SCORE_INT8_ATTN_VALUE_INT: one physical core, one in-flight collectively
shared_engines.QUANTIZE_DEQUANTIZE: one physical core, one in-flight collectively
shared_engines.ADD_SILU_MUL: one vector engine, one in-flight collectively

integer_overflow_error: No runtime detector or error code
error_retirement: Quiescent matched error invalidates destination and drains accepted operations; stops new issue. Otherwise preserve ownership until coordinated reset. No autonomous retry/reset.
DMA_identity: Vendor four-bit tag remains bank ID; internal acceptance FIFO binds exactly-once direction-ordered status to32-bit transaction. A late duplicate after tag reuse cannot be distinguished at vendor interface; never claim generation checking fixes that transport ambiguity.
verification_obligations: wrong/duplicate identity must not release bank
last memory response and output write precede completion
